{
  "sections": [
    {
      "title": "Your medicines",
      "bullets": [
        {
          "id": "b1",
          "text": "Oxycodone 5 mg swallow it every 4 hours only when you need it for pain. Do not drive while taking.",
          "sources": ["p1:L6", "term:q4h", "term:PO", "term:PRN", "drug:oxycodone"]
        },
        {
          "id": "b2",
          "text": "Tylenol 1,000 mg swallow it every 8 hours scheduled for 2 weeks. It helps with pain and fever.",
          "sources": ["p1:L7", "term:q8h", "term:PO", "drug:acetaminophen"]
        },
        {
          "id": "b3",
          "text": "Enoxaparin 40 mg a shot just under the skin once daily for 14 days to prevent blood clots.",
          "sources": ["p1:L8", "term:subQ", "drug:enoxaparin"]
        },
        {
          "id": "b4",
          "text": "Docusate 100 mg swallow it two times a day while taking oxycodone. It helps with constipation.",
          "sources": ["p1:L9", "term:BID", "term:PO", "drug:docusate"]
        },
        {
          "id": "b5",
          "text": "Ondansetron 4 mg swallow it every 8 hours only when you need it for nausea.",
          "sources": ["p1:L10", "term:q8h", "term:PO", "term:PRN", "drug:ondansetron"]
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "med_schedule": [
